instruction.text: Find the adaptations that help the hedgehog protect itself.

feedback.end: Spikes protect hedgehogs by making it difficult for predators to eat them.
Hedgehogs have a very good sense of smell, which helps them find their food and guides them at night.
Hedgehogs have excellent hearing, which also helps them find food and be aware of any predators. However, despite their excellent hearing and sense of smell, hedgehogs have poor eyesight!
